title: Pullman's 18th Street lamp is the district's gas post again
items: The lamp where 18th Street's walk turns into Calumet Avenue, outside Pullman's palm house, was drawn as a tall pale post with a globe head, read off J. W. Taylor's photograph no. 16554. Looked at again with the owner, the photograph shows the same gas lamp as the rest of the street: at its size the district lantern, narrow at the foot and wide at its sky-lit top under a small dark roof, reads like a globe. It now stands as the district's cast-iron post, and its card says so.
